Rumble!! The Horrific Darkest Day (Japanese: ゴゴゴゴ！！恐怖のブラックナイト Menacing!! The Terrifying ) is the 25th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 

==Major events==
Leon summons the Gym Leaders to Rose Tower to confront Rose.
, , Bede, Hop, and Marnie head to Rose Tower.
Oleana battles against the Gym Leaders to prevent them from climbing the tower.
Rose begins the Darkest Day.
Pokémon across Galar begin to Dynamax.
appears above Hammerlocke.
